items.title: PEETO SAR APNE AHLE AZAA WA-WAILAA
items.body:
PEETO SAR APNE AHLE AZAA WA-WAILAA
Maatam Karlo Bekas Ka Wa-wailaa
Aaj Naweeñ Hai Maah e Azaa Ki
Khatm Huwaa Shiyo Ashraa Wa-wailaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Kal Hai Qayamat Ka Samaañ Wa-wailaa
Honge Azaa Khaane Sunsañ Wa-wailaa
Kal Na Alam Hai Aur Na Yeh Mimbar
Aur Na Yeh Bazm e Aah O Bukaa Wa-wailaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Asr Ko Hogaa Kal Kohraam Wa-wailaa
Sajdeh Me Hoge Zibaah Imam Wa-wailaa
Haaye Katega Kund Churi Se Kal Shah e Deeñ Ka Pyaasa Galaa Wa-wailaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Honge Haram Kal Be-Pardaah Wa-wailaa
Lenge Laee'ñ Zainab Ki Ridaa Wa-wailaa
Baazuoñ Me Baandhenge Rasan Kal
Ukhdaa Kushaa Ki Beti Kaa Wa-wailaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Hogaa Yeh Ghar Kal Se Sunsaañ Wa-wailaa
Subah Ko Jaata Hai Mehmaañ Wa-wailaa
Ro'o Zari e Sheh Se Lipat Kar
Hote Hai Ruqsat Kal Maula Wa-wailaa

items.title: BE-SHEER KI GARDAN PAR JAB TEER LAGA HOGA
items.body:
BE-SHEER KI GARDAN PAR JAB TEER LAGA HOGA
Us Waqt Shah e Deeñ Ka Kya Haal Huwa Hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Dete Hue Asghar Ko Shabbir Ki Godi Me
Be-sheer Ka Baano Ne Muh Choom Liya Hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Be-Sheer Ki Nawek Se Gardan Jo Chidi Hogi
Zahra Ke Kaleje Me Nasoor Pada Hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Haathoñ Pe Ali Asghar Jab Kaanp Gaye Hoge
Zahra Ke Pisar Ka Bhi Dil Kaanp Gaya Hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch Ashk Giray Hoge Be-sheer Ki Turbat Par
Shabbir Ne Asghar Ko Jab Dafn Kiya Hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Maidan Me Jab Asghar Dam Tod Rahe Hoge
Us Waqt Me Baano Ko Ek Haul Huwa Hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya Dil Na Jalaa Hoga Us Waqt Me Baano Ka
Jhoola Ali Asghar Ka Jis Waqt Jala Hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
IsKi Bhi Khabar Hilmi Thi Dilbar e Zahra Ko
Be-Sheer Ka Turbat Me Sar Tann Se Judaa Hoga
